name: Trigger Zone
description: An invisible area that knows who is standing in it. Name it, scale it with the gizmo, then have other scripts ask isInZone('<that name>').

changelog.notes: Ships an AI guide (ai.md) the in-app assistant reads before it writes zone code — the full bus API, where a reaction script goes, and the params, describing this exact copy.

Zone settings read as settings, not as a script file. 'cooldown' is now 'exitDelay' — it is boundary hysteresis, not a reaction's rate limit, so it no longer collides with a reaction's own cooldown (the old value resets to the default). The bus can also resolve a reaction's zone from the entity it sits on, so a reaction attached to the zone needs no configuring at all.
Initial release: named trigger area publishing occupancy on the zone bus
